title: Gossipsub topology: per-hierarchy sharding, tip advertisement, DHT fallback
description: Implement the libp2p gossipsub overlay used by the transit daemon for group-state propagation. Topics are per-hierarchy (usenet.hier.comp, usenet.hier.sci, etc.) with in-topic filtering by group name. Tip advertisement messages carry the current tip-set CID. DHT is used as fallback for tip discovery when peers are offline. Backpressure prevents flooding slow peers.
